page.title: The Homestead — a free online farm game in your browser
page.description: Claim a clearing in Banana World and make it a farm: raise hens, goats, sheep and cows, grow crops, cook, and have friends over. Free in your browser.
page.ogDescription: Your own farm in Banana World: hens, crops, cooking and friends dropping by. Free in the browser.
page.tag: your own farm in Banana World

items.q: Is the Homestead free to play?
items.a: Yes. It plays in your browser, with no account and nothing to install, and the clearing is yours from the day you name it.

items.q: What do you do on your Homestead?
items.a: Claim a clearing and name it, sow the seeds you pocket in the park, keep hens and then more animals, cook what they give, and furnish the yard.

items.q: Where do the coins come from?
items.a: From playing anywhere in Banana World: [the rave](/rave/), [the park](/park/) and [the bay](/beach/) all pay, and so does a dish from the kitchen.

items.q: Can other players visit my homestead?
items.a: Yes. Visitors drop by and see the whole yard, and a neighbour can water your beds for you.
Yes, on [your pass](/pass/), on this device from your first step. Add an email to the pass and you can pick it up on another phone or computer.

items.q: How do you get to the Homestead?
items.a: Take the door under the game from anywhere in Banana World and pick The Homestead.
